question_text: Outline why computing an employee’s current age from stored date of birth can avoid an inconsistency caused by separately storing age.
adaptation_rationale: Retains derived-data reasoning as explicit redundancy/consistency benefit; does not claim a separate derived-field taxonomy.
solution: A stored age becomes outdated at a birthday even when the date of birth is correct. Calculating it when needed avoids maintaining two dependent values that can disagree.

marking_points.criterion: Calculation avoids redundant dependent values/update need.
